note: Shared research-compound catalogue for all SmashFat-family peptide sites. Prices in CAD per vial. 'was' is the pre-discount reference price; 'price' is the current sell price (30% network-wide reduction applied 2026-07-27). 'cost' is the PLACEHOLDER landed cost (35% of the pre-discount price) and must be replaced with the real per-vial supplier cost before margin figures mean anything. purity is the release threshold. Descriptions are research-framed. 'new' and stock ('in'|'low') are display flags. Products carrying `sup` are linked to a supplier catalogue code; their cost and price are maintained by `manage.py reprice` from the supplier price list and the live USD/CAD rate.
